text:
Berlin, den 7. December 1800.
An die Süd. Preußische Regierung
zu Posen.
ex officio
Friedrich Wilhelm König p
Unsern p. Da die meiſten Räthe Eürs
Collegii Mitglieder des dortigen Vormund¬
schafts-Collegii sind, und durch das letz¬
tere die Klage des Vormundes der minoren¬
nen Michaelina von Prusimska wider den
Herrn Fürsten von Hohenlohe Ingelfingen
auf Vindication der Brzezier Güther veran¬
laßt, auch unter dessen Direction der Pro¬
ceß selbst betrieben worden, und ferner wird
betrieben werden, so haben wir uns ver¬
anlaßt gefunden, hiermit festzusetzen,
daß die benannte Rechts-Sache in erster
Instanz von dem Pleno der Regierung zu
Warschau, und in zweyter Instanz von
dem Ober-Appellations-Senate des Kam¬
mer Gerichtes abgeurthelt werden soll.
Wir machen Euch solches, und daß deshalb
Dato das Nothige an gedachte beyde Col¬
legia erlassen worden, zur Nachricht und
Achtung hierdurch bekannt; und Sind p.
Berlin, den 7. December 1800.
Ad mandatum.

translation.en:
Berlin, 7 December 1800. To the South Prussian Government at Poznań.

ex officio

Friedrich Wilhelm, King, etc. Our, etc. Since most of the councillors of your court are members of the guardianship board there, and the suit of the guardian of the minor Michaelina von Prusimska against the Prince of Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen for the recovery of the Brzyce estates was brought at the instance of the latter, and the lawsuit itself has been conducted, and will continue to be conducted, under its direction, We have found it necessary hereby to order that the said case shall be decided in the first instance by the full bench of the Government at Warsaw, and in the second instance by the Superior Appeal Senate of the Kammergericht. We hereby make this known to you for your information and observance, together with the fact that the necessary orders have accordingly been sent today to both the said courts; and are, etc. Berlin, 7 December 1800. By command.

# # #

text_english:
Berlin, 7 December 1800. To the South Prussian Government at Poznań.

ex officio

Friedrich Wilhelm, King, etc. Our, etc. Since most of the councillors of your court are members of the guardianship board there, and the suit of the guardian of the minor Michaelina von Prusimska against the Prince of Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen for the recovery of the Brzyce estates was brought at the instance of the latter, and the lawsuit itself has been conducted, and will continue to be conducted, under its direction, We have found it necessary hereby to order that the said case shall be decided in the first instance by the full bench of the Government at Warsaw, and in the second instance by the Superior Appeal Senate of the Kammergericht. We hereby make this known to you for your information and observance, together with the fact that the necessary orders have accordingly been sent today to both the said courts; and are, etc. Berlin, 7 December 1800. By command.

# # #
summary_en: Draft of a royal rescript to the Government at Poznań: since most of its councillors are members of the guardianship board there, which occasioned and directs the suit of Michalina von Prusimska's guardian against the Prince of Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen for the recovery of the Brzyce estates, it is laid down that the case will be decided in the first instance by the full bench of the Government at Warsaw and in the second by the Senate of Higher Appeal of the Kammergericht. Both courts have been instructed the same day.
summary_de: Entwurf eines königlichen Reskripts an die Regierung zu Posen: Da die meisten ihrer Räte Mitglieder des dortigen Vormundschaftskollegiums sind, das die Klage des Vormunds der Michalina von Prusimska gegen den Fürsten von Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen auf Herausgabe der Brzycer Güter veranlasst hat und leitet, wird festgesetzt, dass die Sache in erster Instanz vom Plenum der Regierung zu Warschau und in zweiter vom Oberappellationssenat des Kammergerichts entschieden wird. Beide Kollegien sind am selben Tag angewiesen worden.
